caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a pitcher, rendered in shades of gray, giving it a monochromatic appearance. The pitcher has a wide spout, a large curved handle, and a narrow neck that expands into a bulbous body. The surface of the body features a repeating pattern of raised circular bumps encircling the midsection, with the lower portion of the body covered in a diagonal, scale-like design. The rim and base of the pitcher are smooth, while the decorative elements provide texture and dimension. The pitcher is positioned at an angle, showing the spout, handle, and body details clearly. The drawing is centered on a plain, light-colored background, and the artist's signature, "John Dana," appears at the bottom right corner.
title: Pitcher
